name: Fists of Fury - The Rift

canDoWhy: A letter tells you about a brawling tournament; Maul in Riften points you to a fight club in the Ratway.

needs.what: Gold for the entry fee (the amount isn't in these files)

starts.where: outdoors in Riften; by day near Mistveil Keep, at night asleep in Black-Briar Manor
starts.how: After a letter about a brawling tournament reaches you, talk to Maul; he sends you down into the Ratway to find the Ratway Arena.

firstStep: Find the Ratway Arena down in the Ratway Vaults

takesYou.why: the way down to the arena
the tournament: The Organizer, three contenders and the champion

objectives: Find the Ratway Arena down in the Ratway Vaults
Talk to The Organizer (if you're short of gold, get more and come back)
Defeat The Rift's Champion, Gian the Fist (the game may tell you to come back later and fight him)

people.name: Maul
people.role: tells you where the tournament is

people.name: The Organizer
people.role: runs the Ratway Arena tourney, takes the entry fee and pays out

unsure.why: The first journal line says a letter told you about the tournament, but no record here shows who sends it or what triggers it. A separate Fists of Fury quest with no journal text holds Maul, Niranye and Falion together; it is probably what hands out the leads, but its trigger isn't in these files.

Maul's day package points at an unnamed spot near Mistveil Keep and only runs when its conditions hold; another package has him lean on a wall at his placed spot until a Riften quest moves on. The exact spot isn't named. He sleeps at Black-Briar Manor from midnight for 8 hours.
The journal says to get more gold and return, so there is an entry fee, but the amount isn't in these records.
An objective says to come back later and defeat Gian the Fist; what decides when the champion fight is open (time of day, a wait) isn't in these files.
No reward record is attached to this quest. Gian the Fist is in the trainer faction, so he may offer training afterwards; the records don't say what he trains.

kill Othriel; the quest ends when she is dead

named in the quest's script; when it's given isn't in these files

Gain Heart and Rimeweld Sword are properties on the quest script; the files don't say what Gain Heart does or at which point each is handed over.
The three side quests all centre on Othriel or the Snow Elf mirrors; the records don't show the exact point in this quest that unlocks each.
Othriel is in the potential-follower faction and the quest tracks a relationship score with her; how that score changes isn't in these files.
